# Flag germline GENOTYPE cell when backed by a low-depth control sample (Generated by Claude Sonnet 5)

Mirrors the DP_CONTROL-based flagging previously implemented via
[`DT::formatStyle`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/DT/man/formatCurrency.html):
variants with a real (non-sentinel), low control sequencing depth are
marked with a colored left border and bold text, so that their genotype
call is interpreted with appropriate caution. DP_CONTROL is set to -1
(sentinel) when CPSR is run without a matched control sample, in which
case no styling is applied.

## Usage

``` r
render_genotype_style(data, low_depth_threshold = 10)
```

## Arguments

- data:

  The main data frame (passed via closure)

- low_depth_threshold:

  Sequencing depth (control sample) below which the GENOTYPE cell is
  flagged (default: 10)

## Value

A function that can be used as a reactable cell style renderer for the
GENOTYPE column of the germline findings table
